note: DELETE-mode rollback journal: <db>-journal present during an open write txn, absent after COMMIT and after ROLLBACK; committed row visible, rolled-back row gone
reopen after COMMIT sees the committed rows (durable db file)
ROLLBACK restores the pre-images: UPDATE, DELETE, and a multi-row UPDATE all revert
COMMIT after a multi-row UPDATE persists all pages; a fresh open re-reads them
